title: Utillian 421 Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
The Utillian 421

The Utillian 421 vaporizer is a follow up to the best-selling budget vaporizer, the Utillian 420. The Utillian 421 improves upon its predecessor offering 6 temperature settings, bigger battery, and airflow control, all while maintaining the digital display and glass mouthpiece people loved from the previous model.

It’s a perfect unit for beginners or for those looking for a cost-effective backup vaporizer.

UTILLIAN 421 REPLACEMENT MOUTHPIECES IN STOCK

Features:
– Glass Mouthpiece
– Digital Display
– Compact Design
– Battery Life 1 hour
– Heat time 60 seconds
– Conduction Heating
– 6 Pre-Set Temperatures
– 1 Year Direct Warranty
– Anodized Aluminum Shell
– Ceramic Heating Chamber

Included in the Box:
– Utillian 421
– Mouthpiece Heat Shield
– Packing Tool
– Screens
– USB Cable
